entries.title: The Specifics Swap
entries.summary: 把空泛句子换成数字、工具名或真实例子，不知道就提问不编造。
entries.prompt: Act as a sharp editor. Find every vague line in my text and replace it with a number, a tool name, or a real example. If you don't know the detail, ask me. Never make it up. My text: [paste]
entries.author: AIinPublic

entries.title: The Fluff Cutter
entries.summary: 把文稿砍掉约三分之一，只保留读者真正需要的信息。
entries.prompt: Act as a brutal editor. Cut my text by a third. Remove filler, repeats, and long intros. Keep only what the reader needs. My text: [paste]
entries.author: AIinPublic

entries.title: The Rhythm Fixer
entries.summary: 混搭长短句并砍掉重复短语，让AI草稿读起来像人写的。
entries.prompt: Act as an editor who fixes AI drafts. Rewrite my text so it flows like a person wrote it. Mix short and long sentences. Cut every repeated phrase. Same meaning. My text: [paste]
entries.author: AIinPublic
